figures.subject: Extra memory by input length
figures.summary: How much memory each sort allocates beyond its input as the input grows. Both axes are logarithmic, so memory proportional to a power of n is a straight line, and a steeper line grows faster: sorts that copy their input rise with the input itself, and the dotted line has the slope of √n.
